summary.text: Marshall Rawson is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after defeating Chase Brannan in the August 18, 2026 primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Florida citrus grower, Florida Guard officer and University of Florida law graduate.

paragraphs.text: Marshall Rawson earned a bachelor's degree from Jacksonville University in 2018.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father, Florida citrus grower, Florida Guard officer, UF Law graduate and former NCAA college decathlete.
He won the Republican primary with 54.8% of the vote (12,719 votes) to Chase Brannan's 45.2%.
In the survey, Rawson listed overdevelopment, immigration and the environment, and local government spending as key issues.
He said he wants Florida First policies, and listed revitalizing Florida's labor force, immigration and the environment, and taxpayer advocacy as areas of policy interest.
